newsitem.title: HONG KONG: IBM China venture starts production.
newsitem.headline: IBM China venture starts production.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp's biggest venture in China, Shenzhen Hailiang Storage Product Co Ltd, has started production, the Shenzhen Special Zone Daily said.
Hailiang, with a total investment of US$42.5 million, began turning out computer hard drive components on Tuesday, the newpaper said.

IBM has an 80 percent stake in Hailiang, which was set up with registered capitalisation of US$20 million, with the remaining 20 percent evenly split between Shenzhen Kaifa Technology Co Ltd, a Shenzhen-listed computer parts maker, and China Great Wall Computer Co, the official said.
Hailiang, equipped with four production lines from Japan, expects to produce 36 million components worth US$250 million in 1997, the official said.
